summary: Syntasia is a browser-only narrated-video authoring site served by GitHub Pages. HTML, CSS and compiled TypeScript provide researched single-scene scripts, Speech previews, conditional avatar/SVG video generation, local MP4 assembly and WebVTT downloads.

workspaceSignals.decisionReason: The workspace contains a specification and reference examples, not an implemented Syntasia application.

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Strict TypeScript compiled to browser JavaScript

questions.question: Frontend framework
questions.rationale: Spec.md requires an HTML home page, CSS styling and compiled TypeScript; user confirms browser-only GitHub Pages, no backend.

options.label: None (HTML + CSS + TypeScript)
options.description: Static single-page application without a UI framework

questions.question: Authoritative feature scope
questions.answer: All requirements in spec.md sections 1–14 and AC-01–AC-24, including conditional feasibility and release gates.
questions.rationale: User explicitly chose spec.md, read in full. No feature is removed by this derived requirements file.

questions.question: Application data stores
questions.rationale: Spec.md sections 1 and 4.2: project URL and model only persist locally; all authoring data and media are session-only. Foundry conversation retention is separate.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: No application database or cloud storage; only specified browser settings persist

questions.question: Does the application need user login?
questions.rationale: Spec.md sections 2.1 and 4 specify no application login in v1. Service configuration remains subject to the specification's independent validation gates.
